# Welcome to Dnax UI docs

> Everything you need to build with Dnax UI — components, plugins, directives and guides.

Everything you need to build with **Dnax UI**: 100+ Vue 3 components with a simple
syntax, CSS-token theming, Iconify icons and mobile-ready layouts. Use the sidebar
to navigate, or jump straight to a section below.

## Start here

<prose-card icon="lucide:download" title="Installation" to="/docs/getting-started/installation">

Add `@dnax/ui`, register the Nuxt module and render your first component.

</prose-card>

<prose-card icon="lucide:rocket" title="Setup" to="/docs/getting-started/setup">

First component, theming, CSS tokens and icons in five minutes.

</prose-card>

<prose-card icon="lucide:component" title="Components" to="/docs/components/btn">

100+ components: buttons, forms, overlays, data grid, spreadsheet, editors…

</prose-card>

<prose-card icon="lucide:plug" title="Plugins API" to="/docs/plugins/dialog">

Imperative APIs through `$q`: dialog, bottom sheet, notify, loading, storage…

</prose-card>

## Most used

<prose-card icon="lucide:square-mouse-pointer" title="Button" to="/docs/components/btn">

The `q-btn` — variants, colors, icons, sizes and states.

</prose-card>

<prose-card icon="lucide:text-cursor-input" title="Input" to="/docs/components/input">

Single-line text field with label, validation and affixes.

</prose-card>

<prose-card icon="lucide:list-filter" title="Select" to="/docs/components/select">

Dropdown for single or multiple values (inline, modal, sheet).

</prose-card>

<prose-card icon="lucide:table" title="Table" to="/docs/components/table">

Tabular data with sorting, pagination and selection.

</prose-card>

## How the docs are organised

- **Getting Started** — installation, setup, theming.
- **Layouts** — the app shell: config provider, page, header, footer, sidebar.
- **Styles** — the responsive grid: `q-grid`, `q-col`, `q-row`.
- **Components** — every component, with live demos and a full API reference.
- **Plugins API** — imperative APIs exposed on the `$q` object.
- **Vue Directives** — `v-close`, `v-touch-*`, `v-intersection`.

<prose-callout variant="note">

Every component page follows the same structure: a short lead, interactive demos
with a **Preview** / **Code** toggle, then an **API** block listing **Props**,
**Slots**, **Events** and **Methods**. Props are written in kebab-case in templates
and camelCase in TypeScript.

</prose-callout>
